artifacts.notes: Catalog leaves N36-N37 are artifact PDF pages 40-41. Both pages were rendered and visually inspected. Listings span all-glass, glass-and-silver-mounted, and cut-glass-and-silver-mounted forms, with listed heights from approximately 5.25 to 12.5 inches. These are dated commercial exemplars, not ritual norms.
artifacts.rights_basis: The 1914 United States publication is in the public domain by publication date. The exact Internet Archive scan bytes are not redistributed by Triptych.
